abstract: There has Es layer clutter in the high frequency surface wave radar, and the Es layer clutter has the difference arrival direction with the signal. So a vertically polarized antenna array whose mainlobe is put on the reverse direction of the signal arrival direction and a low sidelobe is put on the direction of the signal arrival direction, can be added as auxiliary antennas in the high frequency surface wave radar system to suppress the Es layer clutter. The clutter-to-signal ratio in the outputs of the auxiliary antennas will affect the suppression of the Es layer clutter in the main antennas. The bigger of the clutter-to-signal ratio in the outputs of the auxiliary antennas, the better suppression result of the Es layer clutter in the main antennas can be achieved. Used the superdirective synthetically method, the auxiliary vertically polarized antenna array will have a lower gain on signal than the main antenna, when it can maintain the same gain on Es layer clutter as the main antenna. So the clutter-to-signal ratio in the outputs of the auxiliary vertically polarized antenna array will be increased, the suppression of the Es layer clutter in the main antennas which use the vertically polarized antenna array as auxiliary antenna will be more effective.

articleTitle: A logic-based approach to network security risk assessment
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: An important problem in network security risk assessment is to uncover network threats due to current software vulnerabilities and misconfigurations. This paper proposes a logic-programming approach to conduct this risk assessment automatically. We use Datalog to specify network security property states and attack rules. The threat analysis could be conducted by a logic-programming engine that can evaluate Datalog efficiently (such as XSB). We analyze trace proofs produced by the reasoning engine, and get threat information of evaluated network system. After identifying the threats, we apply game theory to compute threat risks. A simple network attack has been simulated to illuminate the appliance of the new approach. Results on how the approach has been able to help the system administrator understand the threat risks of attacks and take countermeasures accordingly are also analyzed.

articleTitle: A sort of discrete backward stochastic differential equations and its convergence
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: By making discrete filtration, we study a sort of discrete backward stochastic differential equations (BSDEs) with Duffie & Epstein's type. Based on the properties of those filtrations, we prove the existence and uniqueness of the solutions. Finally, we discuss the numerical stability and convergence of the discrete BSDEs.

articleTitle: On employer brand construction of Chinese enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Building and extension of employer brand of enterprises has become a hotspot widely concerned by enterprises in recent years, especially internationally known enterprises. While in China, due to universally weak awareness, the building of employer brand is far from adequate. Based on high significance of building employer brand, this Article, starting from analysis on connotation of employer brand, pointed out problems in building employer brand in Chinese enterprises and explored strategies in building employer brand in terms of communication mechanism and integrated dissemination.

articleTitle: A new threshold signature scheme based on ECC and factoring
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Most of the existing digital signature schemes were developed based on a single hard problem like factoring, discrete logarithm or elliptic curve discrete logarithm problems. In this paper, we proposed a new threshold signature scheme based on multiple hard problems namely factoring and elliptic curve discrete logarithm problems. We combined the two problems into both signing and verifying equations. The new scheme was shown to be secure against the known attacks for signature schemes. The efficiency performance of our scheme is given. Our scheme provides longer and higher security level than that scheme based on one problem.

articleTitle: Study on stability of wide flow based on fuzzy-PID self-organizing control
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The stability of automatic sub-output control system in long-distance pipelines has an important significance to the operational safety. For the PID control parameter of the output control system set difficultly and the problem about the unstable sub-output pressure and flow in small flow, an self-organizing PID parameter controller which is based on the fuzzy control theory has been designed. the controller can adjust the K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">P</sub>,K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">I</sub>,K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub> parameters in time according to the deviation and deviation's rate of change. It has improved that the control if of excellent dynamic property and stable-state property which achieve better output controlling results in natural gas output system. There are practical significance and theoretical reference for the improvement of industrial control system dynamic behavior.

articleTitle: Application of DM in data safety of machine learning based on combined grey neural network
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Using the theory of grey system, DM technology and radial basis function (RBF) neural network method, a new model, the combined model of grey system and RBF neural network is setup, which aims at solving the user's received data safety of machine learning. The results show that, in short-term prediction of data safety of machine learning, GM is an effective way and RBF has perfect ability to study and map. The combined model of grey system and neural network, to a large extent, has the dual properties of trend and fluctuation under the condition of combining with the time-dependent sequence data. It is concluded that great improvement comparing with any method of trend prediction and simple factor in combined grey neural network (CGNN) comparing with the any model of grey system and RBF neural network in data safety of machine learning of machine learning.

articleTitle: Investment risks evaluation on high-tech projects based on analytic hierarchy process and BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In view of the existing problems of investment risks evaluation on high-tech industry projects such as a lack of systematic, with too much subjectivity and from the point to improve evaluation efficiency and effectiveness, the paper combined analytic hierarchy process (AHP) with BP neural network to establish a new and suitable risk evaluation model of high-tech projects. Firstly, we applied AHP to construct a comprehensive risk evaluation index system and screened the evaluation indexes according to their weights. On this basis, using MATLAB software with BP neural network model, we carried out example simulations and results were analyzed. The results showed that the combination model of analytic hierarchy process with BP neural network model (AHP-BPNN) is effective.

articleTitle: A dynamic data mining model for engineering management
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Data mining has become increasingly critical for the success of companies in this emerging era of engineering management. As engineering management activities increasingly shift to the Web, the challenge facing corporate management is maintaining competitive advantage by building strong relations with employees, customers, and suppliers and partners. A good data mining strategy can help achieve this goal. Unfortunately, many companies use data mining technologies that do not suit today's new information era. This paper addresses the definitions about data mining, area of data mining, development of data mining, then provide an summary of the driving and impeding forces that help and hinder proper deployment of data mining strategies in engineering management. Finally, the paper advocates the strategy of data mining for engineering management.

articleTitle: Based on data mining electrical equipment condition monitoring and fault diagnosis technology research
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The electrical equipments operation status monitoring, operating performance analysis and assessment is to ensure the safe operation of its important components. A new trouble pattern analysis was put forward based on thought of data mining. The trouble information dimensionality tables come into being by collecting and cleaning up the fault phenomenon. The association rule dimensionality table was made up of the technique parameters and the trouble causes. We analyzed the trouble information by frequent item set of the Apriori arithmetic based on the trouble information dimensionality table and the association rule dimensionality table. We made sure the causes of the trouble and chose the priority resolving scheme by matching the trouble and building and filtrating the candidates. A process of data mining was designed for status information and fault information, Practical results show that the automation level of the management and diagnosis for electrical equipment is improved and it is of great practical value.

articleTitle: A study of the micro-management system of Chinese professional football clubs
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Most of the related research focuses on the macromanagement system (MAMS), but the micromanagement system (MIMS) is the core element of the clubs' administration. With the related literatures and investigations, we analyzed the micromanagement system of Chinese professional football clubs. We found that the clubs' organizational structure design around the teams' match performance; some important responsibilities, as market exploring, public relationships, etc, are not concluded; the head-coachs' rights are restricted by the club owner and the team leader; some posts' rights are not equal with their status. According with the development level of Chinese professional football clubs, we give some related suggestions which may help the clubs to improve their MIMS.

articleTitle: The edge detection technology of CT image for study the growth of rock crack
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Coal seam is a dynamic and nonlinear system, building a analysis model tally with the actual situation is necessary to numerical simulation. the growth of rock crack is the most informasion for coal mine safety, image processing technology of rock crack is introduced into the analysis of growth of crack, it use the algorithm of wavelet transform to detect the edge of CT image, the crack would be quantitative measured. Simulation verifies the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Statistical uyhur POS tagging with TAG predictor for unknown words
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Automatic text tagging is an important component in higher level analysis of text corpora, and its output can be used in many natural language processing applications. Trigrams tags is an efficient statistical part-of-speech tagging. This paper describes a POS tagging for Uyhur text based on hidden Markov model using trigrams tags. We describe the basic model of Trigrams Tags, the techniques used for smoothing to address the sparse data problem and a tag predictor for unknown words. A comparison has shown that our approach performs significantly for the Uyhur tested corpora.

articleTitle: A security framework for wireless network based on public key infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper proposed a security framework for wireless network based on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) which aims to answer these questions that how to solve the security problem in wireless network between the client operation and service operation. It illustrates the model by presenting a modified security framework for a variety of applications than traditional PKI framework. Our aim is to show the new security framework in wireless network that the traditional wireless network does not have.

articleTitle: An empirical study of the impact of role conflict on job satisfaction for middle school PE teachers
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper aims to research the impact of the multiple roles of middle school PE teachers on their job satisfaction, through interview and questionnaire survey. SPSS11.5 is used to make descriptive statistical analysis, correlation and regression data analysis of the 229 subjects involved in the survey. The results show that most role conflict has a negative impact on job satisfaction for middle school PE teachers.

articleTitle: Fuzzy mathematics' application in marking examination papers
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The core theory of this article is solving the problem of marking examination papers using Fuzzy similarity selection of Fuzzy mathematical theory. The method considers not only the scores given by every teacher but also every teacher's weigh value. We can give a reasonable and fair method of marking examination papers using this method.

articleTitle: Efficient fault-prone software modules selection based on complexity metrics
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In order to improve the software reliability early, this paper proposes an efficient algorithm to select fault-prone software module. Based on software module's complexity metrics, the algorithm uses modified cascaded-correlation algorithm as neural network classifier to select the fault-prone software module. Finally, by analyzing the algorithm's application in the project MAP, the paper shows the advantage of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Enhanced ODMRP using conditioned broadcasting algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Broadcasting is a common operation in on-demand multicast routing protocol to establish and refresh routing table. A straightforward broadcasting by flooding is usually very costly and will result in serious redundancy and contention. A conditioned broadcasting algorithm for on-demand multicast routing protocol is proposed, which computes the rebroadcast probability of packets through neighbor node density and relative distance. By applying this algorithm to on-demand multicast routing protocol in ns-2 platform, the simulation results show that the proposed algorithm improves the protocol efficiency and reduces the redundant information.

articleTitle: Entropy based audio watermarking in image using wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel algorithm for robust audio watermarking in image using wavelet transform based on an image entropy. The motivation of choosing image as a cover is driven by the fact that human visual system is less sensitive than human auditory system thus an image provides better masking effect. The algorithm is based on decomposition of images using Daubechies wavelet basis. The technique proposed in this paper resolves the problem of severe distortion caused by watermarking audio in an image by developing a scaling function that achieves maximum robustness and transparency prior to its embedding. The property of texture is used as a criterion to identify the target area for embedding the watermark. The security of the algorithm is enhanced by performing a random permutation of the watermark. The hidden data can be recovered reliably under certain attacks such as global tampering, localized tampering and contrast enhancement.

articleTitle: A novel quasi-newton image reconstruction algorithm for electrical capacitance tomography system
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: To solve the electrical capacitance tomography(ECT) technology ldquosoft fieldrdquo effect and pathological problem, a quasi-Newton new algorithm for electrical capacitance tomography is presented. On the basis of analyzing ECT system measurement principle, constructing corrector formula of secant approximation algorithm in second-order information items of objective functions. The feasibility of using this algorithm for ECT problems is also discussed. It shows that it is easy to meet the convergence condition and error of image reconstruction is small. Experimental results and simulation data indicate that the algorithm can provide high quality images and favorable stabilization compared with LBP and conjugate gradient algorithms and this new algorithm presents a feasible and effective way to research on image reconstruction algorithm for electrical capacitance tomography system.

articleTitle: Design and development of long-distance virtual teaching system based on VRML and JAVA languages
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper discusses a long-distance virtual teaching platform based on VRML-JAVA language which is realistic and interactive information construction and scene guided by situational learning theories in views of insufficiency in modern long-distance network teaching. Based on characteristics of VRML and JAVA language, we introduce the structure and function of this platform to realize the platform key technologies including building the virtual scene construction, the substitute person, the community sensation and so on, which makes beneficial exploration in distance education.

articleTitle: Cache optimization for real time MPEG-4 encoder
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Due to the speed up of the VLSI technology, the high speed of the DSP core is not compatible with much lower speed external memory. The low speed of the off-chip memory, which is mainly responsible for the DSP delays, all that was called memory wall. The memory wall seriously confined the DSP's computation capability for the intense data exchange algorithm. This paper provides two strategies (Regulation the L2 cache, adjust the encoding procedure) to speed up the performance of the Cache which based on the study of the architecture of the TMS320DM642 two level cache and the algorithm flow of the MPEG-4 encoder.

articleTitle: Population interaction model applied in lateral coopetition relations of cluster supply chain
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This article, studying the lateral competition relations of cluster supply chain between enterprises from the perspective of population ecology theory, will apply population ecology theory to the research in the field of cluster supply chain system, which is of great significance to the exploration of the construction of basic theory of inter-enterprise cluster supply chain relationship under the set theory group of eco-based organizations; This article identifies the motivation of enterprise cooperation and competition in industrial clusters from the perspective of population ecology, and proposes corresponding relationship patterns between cooperation and competition for various enterprises in industrial clusters, from which we could further have a profound understanding theoretically of a variety of patterns of competition between enterprises.

articleTitle: Relationship benefits in services markets: The integrative structure model
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In recent years, the concept of relationship benefits has attracted increasing attention among marketing researchers and practitioners. Despite a growing body of literature in this area, no generally accepted integrative structure model have emerged from the marketing literature. The present paper investigates the structure of relationship benefits, based on the theoretical foundations of relational bonds, identifies three basic classifications of relationship benefits. It is suggested that relationship benefits should be conceptualized as a multi-dimensional, higher-order structure model. These structure model and classifications are tested using data from a survey among some 300 customers of the services of hairdressers. The findings of this article are directions for future research and managerial implications.

articleTitle: MSA based on bearing thickness auto-measuring and classifying system
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: A Measurement System Analysis, abbreviated MSA, is a specially designed experiment that seeks to identify the components of variation in the measurement. Just as processes that produce a product may vary, the process of obtaining measurements and data may have variation and produce defects. A Measurement Systems Analysis evaluates the test method, measuring instruments, and the entire process of obtaining measurements to ensure the integrity of data used for analysis (usually quality analysis) and to understand the implications of measurement error for decisions made about a product or process. MSA is an important element of Six Sigma methodology and of other quality management systems. Our self-developed bearing thickness auto-measuring and classifying system can not only inspect and separate different precision of bearing bushes, but also display test data sheet of each bearing bush. It goes fleetly and effective with low inspection error, which meets a number of different industries' use demand on the different precision of bearing bushes. This paper is introduced by the factors of inspection device, production device, products, personal, and so on. It assesses the inspection device with the index of stability, repeatability, reproducibility, bias and linearity, in order to improve the quality of measurement dates and further improve product quality.

articleTitle: A comprehensive inventory forecasting model based on data mining of demand system
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: There are complex grey correlations among different demands of products as well as ones between demands and inventories. In terms of the nature of huge data reflecting this tough grey system in market, we manage to design a comprehensive inventory forecasting model, which is based on the data mining of market demand and inventory serial data. Grey theory is applied to reserve the essence of system while a data mining method is designed to screen the serial data to target critic ones as basis to inventory forecast. The model can produce valuable information about the tendency of inventory in near future.

articleTitle: Research on the remote monitoring and controlling based on VSP
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Traditional PLC software about programming and monitoring all were designed in serial port debugging mode based on local. So the remote monitoring and controlling function couldn't be realized in the mode. In the article the virtual serial port (VSP) technology was imported into the system and it turned the PLC serial port software from local control function to remote one. In the system, the real serial port was replaced by virtual one. The client captured the command frames getting across the VSP, and then the instructions were sent to server through internet. And server program transferred the command to PLC by real serial port of local upper computer and correlation datum backtracked after PLC response. The Cx-programmer (Omron PLC software) was applied in the experiment and the ladder of Cx-p come into being switching on and disconnecting by returning datum. And according to the changes, the running state of local equipments could be known. This system was debugged by the experiment successfully.

articleTitle: Application of extended kalman filter in the detection of sorption problem in hybrid maglev system with controlled permanent magnet
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The sorption problem is one of the crucial problems in the electromagnetic suspension vehicles, which could lead to fatal sequent. To detect the sorption trend, a methods of comparing the measured value of gap with the threshold of protection gap is introduced. Yet, the measured value of gap is influenced by sample noise and electromagnetic interference. In this paper, the detection of sorption problem in hybrid maglev system is researched on, and a gap observer based on extended Kalman filter is designed to reduce the probability of inaccurate judgement of the sorption trend in hybrid maglev system. At last, the method has been proved available by simulation.

articleTitle: Robust stability analysis of commensurate fractional order interval polynomials
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper deals with robust stability of commensurate fractional order interval polynomials. Tan et al. obtain the robust stability result of fractional order interval polynomials. The result is that the fractional order interval polynomial is robustly stable if and only if all the exposed edge polynomials are robustly stable. In this paper, some simplification is presented for robust stability of the commensurate fractional order interval polynomials. That is, the commensurate fractional order interval polynomial is robustly stable if and only if all the outer edge polynomials are robustly stable. The problem of robust stability of commensurate fractional order interval polynomials can be changed to the problem about the zero exclusion principle for its value set.

articleTitle: An available bandwidth measurement method based on the parity-packet pair model
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: A new end-to-end available bandwidth measurement method based on the parity-packet pair model is proposed on the basis of analyzing the relationship between the separation time and background traffic of the packet pair. This method breaks the constraint that the tense link and the bottleneck link must be the same link, and is able to measure the end-to-end available bandwidth, even in many complex situations. The experiment results prove the exactness and effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Bit error rate (BER) performance enhancement technique of a wireless fading channel
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Antenna diversity technique improves the instantaneous and average signal to noise ratio (SNR) by combining all the diversity branches. The channel noise and fading reduce the performance of any communication system through making loss of some information of the transmitted symbol. In this paper, we mathematically represented the effect of noise and multi-path fading on the transmitted signal. Then we performed a computer simulation study to show the BER performance of the fading channel and also showed how the BER performance of the fading channel could be improved by Antenna diversity technique.

articleTitle: Robust location estimation with possibilistic clustering
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In this paper we consider the weighted (1-center) location problems weighted by the Possibilistic clustering method. Such weighting method leads to better robustness to outliers compared with minimax location estimation. Its effectiveness was further verified by the experiments on the artificial dataset.

articleTitle: Data hiding in MP3 audio by modifing QMDCT coefficients
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: According to the characteristic of mp3 encoding, we propose a data hiding method for mp3 audio by modifying quantized modify discrete cosine transformation (QMDCT) coefficients. Due to frequency masking model of Human Audio System (HAS) in quantization phase, the noise which is produced by data embedding will be controlled within allowed distortion. Our method is simply and with high data hiding capacity and excellent imperceptibility. The experiment results show that a large amount of data inserted into mp3 audio, especially at high compression ratio, while keeping it inaudible..

articleTitle: An evolutionary relevance calculation measure in topic crawler
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In recent years, relevance calculation of Web page and the topic has been one of the important and valuable hotspot. And relevance calculation between the Web page and the topic becomes a key factor. However, the traditional calculations of the topic relevance have lots of defects. For example, high cost, vector length disturbance, excessive high MAE and so on... This paper provides a new algorithm named AdjustJaccard to get the relevance according to the analyses of the traditional calculation of the topic relevance. The results proved the method is highly effective.

articleTitle: Supply chain enterprises cooperative game analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper discusses a cooperative game model on a three-stage supply chain composed of manufacturer, distributor and retailer, and puts forward a cooperative profit allocation tactics. The paper sets up three models for no enterprise cooperation, partial enterprises cooperation and all enterprises cooperation respectively. And get the profit of each alliance by backward induction. In the end, we get the conclusions that the profit of enterprise makes an alliance more than that independently operate.

articleTitle: A quadratic-residue-based fragile watermarking scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: A new fragile watermarking scheme for image authentication and location of areas that have been tampered with is proposed in this paper. Based on a quadratic-residue theorem, the proposed scheme generates the watermark block-by-block in the cover image. To improve security by preventing malicious attacks, such as the vector quantization attack, a pseudo-random number generator using a private key as a seed is applied in the embedding process. The experimental results show that our proposed scheme is effective in image authentication and maintains high image quality in the watermarked images. In addition, areas that have been tampered with can be located and at least approximately recovered.

articleTitle: Doctored JPEG image detection based on double compression features analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Identifying the authenticity and integrity of digital images becomes increasingly important in digital forensics. In this paper, we focus on JPEG images and propose an effective method for detecting doctored images. We first investigate the statistical characteristics of DCT coefficients based on a recompression files sets, and analyze the differences of double compression effect between doctored and non-doctored region in a doctored image. We then extract the DCT coefficients histograms of each block in doctored images and represent them as feature vectors. We identify the location of doctored region by using SVM classification for evaluating the feature vectors. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can efficiently detect and automatically locate doctored regions on different forgeries with low computational complexity.

articleTitle: The application of unascertained measurement model in intellectual capital management of construction enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Intellectual capital management in the context of knowledge-based economy are important means of the construction enterprises survival and development. According to analyze constituent elements of intellectual capital, the index system was proposed by human capital, management capital, technology capital, market capital, information capital, unascertained measurement model of intellectual capital management was established. Applications used by the model shows that the evaluation result can objectively reflect the intellectual capital management of construction enterprises, a new method and way was provided for evaluation of intellectual capital management, it has theoretical and practical value. Due to the ordered division of evaluation space, the resolution was improved by unascertained measure model. It has reliable evaluation result, it is a practical model.

articleTitle: The design and application of UPnP & IGRS supported lightweight DMA software framework
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: With the growing popularity of digital home, digital multimedia applications are in rapid development. Digital media adapter (DMA) in home network is very popular in recent years. However, some problems come out while applying the standard A/V application framework for DMA software, for examples, device's overloaded tasks, and low device's applicability of the DMA software, etc. Addressing these issues, it brings forward the UPnP & IGRS supported lightweight DMA software framework. Moreover, it has adopted the new framework to a cell phone media player project. And it proves that the new framework can not only reduce the loads of DMA terminal device, but also conveniently realizes more high-end demands, so as to improve device's applicability of DMA application.

articleTitle: Scheduling jobs on parallel batch processing machines
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In this paper we consider the problem of scheduling jobs with and without release dates on parallel unbounded batch processing machines to minimize total completion time. We show that the problem with release dates is strongly NP-hard by a reduction from the strongly NP-hard 3-Partition problem and develop a dynamic programming algorithm for the problem without release dates.

articleTitle: Dynamic material picking schedule and communication protocols for warehouse picking system
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper proposes dynamic material picking schedule, analyzes the problem of determining the formats of the communication infrastructure in a real-time picking system as well as determining the specifications of the communication protocols. An execution process of the sequence for picking/inputting tasks is defined. Relationship between communication specifications is discussed. Experimental results are shown that the proposed communication protocols provide good performance.

articleTitle: The influence of inspection error on single screening procedure under onesided specification
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The screening problem, namely, observing the screening variable rather than directly observing the performance variable, has been studied for a long time. However, inspection error which frequently occurs in a screening process has not been investigated in previous research. In this paper, we proposed a two-stage single screening procedure under one-sided specification in order to gain insight into this issue. Stage I is the classic screening procedure, whilst in Stage II we developed an effective index of inspection to calculate the cutoff limit taking into account of the influence of inspection error. Additionally, we analysed the influence of inspection error if we ignore it, and it was demonstrated that once the true selection ratio (beta) is given, the effective index of inspection inversely changed with the ratio of sigma<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>/sigma<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> (a reflection of the precision level). The software simulation results showed that the inspection error should not be ignored in the screening problem.

articleTitle: 3D reservoir modelling with the aid of artificial neural networks
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper presents a study using artificial neural networks (ANN)to perform automatic estimation of rock permeability in a reservoir scale. Three well log responses (acoustic time, gamma-ray and deep induction) were used to predict formation permeability. Permeability from core data and conventional computing have been used to test the results of the neural network. Results from the ANN are in good agreement with core analysis and better than conventional computing data. Based on artificial neural network, combining with the thought of facies controlled modeling, this study presents a reasonable and valuable method to establish the 3D reservoir model, which could provide significant geological and geophysical basis for the further research of improving recovery ratio and the potential of residual oil. Finally, it is shown that the application of artificial neural networks in permeability prediction reduces costs and predicts the reservoir properties more accurately.

articleTitle: Security evaluation of proactive secret sharing cryptosystem
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The proactive secret sharing (PSS) scheme divides the lifetime of a secret into a series of time periods, in which the shares are periodically updated without changing the secret. This paper proposes a practical method for evaluating and analyzing the security of PSS cryptosystem. Based on the response of server to the mobile attack, we apply the stochastic modeling techniques to depict the state transition of PSS cryptosystem, transferring from secure states to the compromised states. With the relationship of security to the threshold, the time period and the intrusion rate, an evaluation of security is obtained. The simulation figures show that the method is practical and applicable.

articleTitle: Defects of constraints on Chinese entrepreneurs' behaviors
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Constraint mechanism for entrepreneurs' behaviors bear function of demarcate entrepreneurs' behaviors and maintain sound order of economic activities, and therefore it is indispensible institutional condition for corporate operation and market economic activities. This article discusses the restriction mechanism of the Chinese entrepreneurs from two aspects: external restrictions and internal restrictions, and it points out that the behavior of Chinese entrepreneurs lacks of restriction mechanism. What's more, the article has analyzed several major problems and makes some recommendations for improvement.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent CAN communication PCI card based on dual-port ram
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This article introduces a kind of Intelligent PCI CAN bus card based on the dual-port RAM(DRAM). First, the whole scheme of the system is presented, then the designs of the hardware and software of Intelligent PCI card Based on CAN bus are expatiated and focused on the structure of DRAM, the general mechanism for the data exchange between the HOST and DEVICE and the communication in I/O and message oriented protocols. the design of whole system is universal, reliability, real-time and expandable.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis on motivating in the management of Chinese and foreign sports teams
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Motivating is a very important part in the management of sports team, effective motivating will make sports management more actively. The author elaborated the current situation of motivation in the management of Chinese and foreign sports teams, and analyzed the main traits of current research, and did some comparative analysis on related issues, which conducted to make effective motivating play a more important role in the management of sports team and provided some suggestions for some departments.

articleTitle: Development of coaches' transformational leadership
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The core of coaches' transformational leadership is to improve their idealized influence or charisma, and behavirol ability of intellectual stimulation, inspiritual motivation and individual consideration. Coaches' transformational leadership development is important for themselves' career promotion, sports teams' success and education to talented athletes. Sports management department should take appropriate measures to enhance the role of coaches for their own understanding of leadership; to strengthen the job training of coaches and to enhance coaches' transformational leadership in all dimensions.

articleTitle: To design logic circuits by using symmetrical coordinate
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Limited to the methods used before in designing logic circuits, not a same tool could be used to design both the combined circuits and the time-sequential circuits. The symmetrical coordinate system stated in this article can be constructed to represent various states of multi-dimensional logical variables. Using the symmetrical coordinate system, it is not only possible to complete the design of combined circuits, but also to carry out all the procedures needed in the design of time-sequence circuits. Thus the combined circuits and the time-sequential circuits can be easily designed with a same design tool. Examples are given in this article to illustrate how to use the system of symmetrical coordinate to design the logic circuits.

articleTitle: CCCM 2009 keynote speech
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Provides an abstract of the keynote presentation and a brief professional biography of the presenter. The complete presentation was not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: The empirical study on the ladderlike development trend of textile industry
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: No one has a suspicion that China is a world textile big country, but people have a fuzzy know which are the textile big provinces and textile strong provinces in China. Therefore, studying the development mode of regional textile industry in China is of very important significance for continuously driving the sustainable development of China's textile industry. Under the background, the paper quantificationally analyzed the regional development characteristics of China's textile industry, namely the ladderlike development mode from the east to west and a wide gap between the competiveness of the east and mid-west region, and pointed out the textile strong provinces in China are only a few provinces while the two-third provinces are textile weak provinces. Thus, the task of changing China from world textile big country into world textile strong country is still a very arduous task.

articleTitle: An identification method based on the DE and NLJ hybrid algorithm and its application
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Identification the accurate model is crucial and initial step for applying advanced process control. A hybrid system identification method is proposed in this paper. This combination algorithm is designed to take both advantage of differential evolution (DE) and new Luss-Jaakola (NLJ) algorithm, which use the DE to search the initial parameters for the NLJ algorithm. The results of simulation have verified its effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Hybrid ant colony algorithm for QAP
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Ant colony algorithm (ACA), inspired by the food-searching behavior of ants, is an evolutionary algorithm and performs well in discrete optimization. In this paper, through an analysis of the constructive procedure of the solution in the ACA, a hybrid ant colony system (PLSACA) with Pareto local search (PLS), is proposed. In PLSACA, only partial facilities are randomly chosen to compute the designed probability and some of the solutions are intensified using local search. Computational results demonstrate that our algorithm generates competitive results compared to the best known solutions of the test instances.

articleTitle: Application of data mining technique in data transmission of E-commerce based on combined grey neural network
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Using grey system, data mining technology and radial basis function neural network, the grey system combined model and neural network, is setup, which is a effective model and the key to solve the data safety. The results show that GM is an effective way and has perfect ability to be studied and mapped in predicting data safety in the short-term period. The combined model with grey system and neural network has the properties of trend and fluctuation while the condition is combining with the time-dependent sequence data in prediction of data transmission during e-commerce activities. It is concluded that great improvement is obtained while comparing with the methods of trend prediction and simple factor in combined model of grey system and neural network.

articleTitle: Adaptive dynamic model particle filter for visual object tracking
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: One of the key issues related to object tracking is the representation of the object motion. It is a challenging problem because the object usually exhibits complex and rich dynamic behavior. In this paper, we propose an adaptive dynamic model to describe the dynamics/motion of the object and embed it into the particle filter framework for visual object tracking. The model characterize the object motion preciously by a switch-and-fusion strategy, which integrates both long period and short period motion information by the combination of multiple simple motion models. Experimental results demonstrate that, the proposed method achieves better results than the conventional particle filter, especially when the object moves quickly and changes the motion pattern drastically.

articleTitle: On construction of logistics system for agricultural production means market in the context of new countryside construction
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Development of logistics system in the market of agricultural means of production is the safeguard for smooth progress of agricultural production. Starting from related concepts on logistics system of agricultural production means market, this Article, explored its major characteristics and made deep consideration on its construction direction.

articleTitle: Organizational values: A review
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The investigative study of values is an important part of organizational culture research. Firstly, this article reviews the concept of values and organizational values, after that, elaborates the development of domestic and foreign researches on organizational values, with commentary on organizational values' researches.

articleTitle: On the condition of the research on human resources management in sports organizations and the construction of the discipline
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: With the rising of research on human resources management in Western countries, China is also faced with the mission of strengthening the research in this area. By literature and logic analysis, this paper reviews and analyses the themes, the hot spots and the trends of the research in the field of HRM in sports organizations. The study points out that China needs to take out some actions to develop the discipline through clarifying the objectives, expanding research areas, deepening study contents, improving research methods, establishing a system of academic methodology, carrying out local researches and building a human resource management model adaptable to Chinese sports organizations.

articleTitle: Research on home base station synchronization method in TD-SCDMA system
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper provides a time synchronization method which is suitable for TD-SCDMA home base stations, based on existing solutions to solve the problem of home base station's time synchronization problem. It presents two operating modes to TD-SCDMA home base station, namely UE operating mode and home base station operating mode. Before entering home base station operating mode, it achieves the TD-SCDMA home base station's time synchronization by the open-loop synchronization of TD-SCDMA macro-stations or other TD-SCDMA home base stations, with monitoring the surrounding TD-SCDMA macro base stations or other TD-SCDMA home base station's downlink synchronization channel at UE operating mode. Finally it analyzes the key technologies, and gives the corresponding solutions.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access
Author Keywords: home base station operating mode component

articleTitle: Research on financial signals' fractal characteristics based on wavelet theory and correlated dimension model
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Efficient market theory is always the cornerstone to establish and study modern financial theory. But its explanatory power for financial markets is weakening with the appearing of financial crisis. Rapid development of nonlinear science such as wavelet analysis and fractal theory provides new theoretical tools for groping financial market. Taking intraday closing price of soybean futures on Dalian Commodity Exchange in 2008 for example, the paper uses wavelet analysis to decompose financial signals into low-frequency and high-frequency parts, and then uses fractal dimension theory to calculate fractal correlated dimensions of low-frequency and high-frequency signals respectively. Results show that structures of signals' low-frequency and high-frequency parts are different, and the long-term memory abilities are different either. Thus, to establish models for low-frequency part and high-frequency part respectively can improve the model's precision when modeling with financial signals.

articleTitle: Private equity exit risk avoiding base on multi-objective optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper build a private equity exit risk avoiding model base on risk-weight exit return using grey relational analysis. We analysis the risk exist in private equity exit process. The human resources, executive management, timing, exit cost exit propagandize and hiring of exit consultants is the mainly risk in private equity exit. The exit ratio of return, exit cost, exit degree, exit realization speed, related staff attitude and exit environment are the impact factors contributed to these exit risk. We use 18 sub-indicators to evaluate these six impact factors. Get the optimal solution of multi-objective risk avoiding model. An example is used to demonstrate the model in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on cost control based on expert system and SOA structure
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper studies cost control system and knowledge management system, and presents a cost control structure of large scaled complex product development based on SOA, which is the mainstream system building ideology. Moreover, this paper gives a knowledge representation and inference engine of this kind of expert system, which enables the knowledge base and reasoning ability to be realized in an isolated way. As a whole, there is a high maintainability and a reasonable structure of the system.

articleTitle: Research on layout of wireless location application based on 3G platform
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Based on the wireless communication platform provided by 3G mobile communication systems, this paper studies wireless location application solutions and provides a new application system solution. Also, this paper expounds the system principle, framework design and specific technical layout of the new application system solution.

articleTitle: Embedded systems based modular test automation
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper discusses the relationships between the modular design methods of the embedded software systems and module test automation. In the basic software modular design processes, provide a standard test interface for driving and calling the modules by the test codes. Testers can design the corresponding test script statements based on the standard of test interfaces and use the test script statements and test script interpretative tools to generate the test codes automatically along with driving the modules and record the test results, and then evaluate the test codes to achieve module test automation and improve the efficiencies and qualities of the tests.

articleTitle: Ecological environment dynamics of Jinjiang city in China based on 3S integrative technology
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Based on multi-temporal remote sensing images of Jinjiang City in China acquired in 1988 and 2001, we identified the characteristics and the classification systems of its ecological environment. By interpreting the thematic map of ecological environment in this area and analyzing the existing land use situation, two maps were obtained for these two different periods of time. A spatio-temporal analysis model was established to analyze the ecological environment quantity, characteristics of their distribution and the rule of their dynamic changes. The results indicate that the ecological environment of residence for urban and rural areas has increased greatly, while the area of platform dry land decreases sharply. The significant changing city can be divided into three regions: the northeastern developing region, the southwestern developing region and the central establishing region. With the adoption of Markov process mode, the result shows that ecological environment of Jinjiang is in a continuous changing status. Dry land and paddy field reduce gradually, while artificial buildings especially urban residential area increases by degrees. The change will probably continue for a long time before it reaches a relatively stable state eventually. This also suggests that Jinjiang will form its own new ecological environment pattern with integration of urban and rural economy in future.

articleTitle: Application of robust public-key watermarking in coal mining information construction process
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper explored the application of robust public-key watermarking in coal mining information construction combining the practice. After the requirement analysis of the electric equipment operation tickets (EEOT) integrity and robust security, it is proposed a solution scheme combining the robust watermarking technology and hash algorithm. The scheme used the certification information which generated by hash algorithm, and it was embedded into its image using robust public-key digital watermarking algorithm, so the EEOT contents can be double authentication. The platform and key technology were also introduced in the paper. From the performance in practice, the scheme is usable and it can make sure of the security and reliability of EEOT.

articleTitle: The design and research of RBAC model based on web
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Nowadays the enterprise informatization is more and more important in the development of an enterprise. With the development of enterprises' informatization construction, more attention than ever before is paid to the security of information management RBAC, as a substitute of traditional access control mechanism Discretionary Access Control (DAC) and Mandatory Access Control (MAC), the concept can meet the application of enterprise-level's access control management which have more users and different role systems. RBAC can protect the enterprise information from danger.

articleTitle: A rule-based decision subsystem design approach for intelligent robot
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: A rule-based forward reference approach was proposed for the decision subsystem of the intelligent robot to avoid the complex decision logic and difficulties in improving the performance of the heuristic direct control solutions and to decrease the response time of machine-learning based intelligent approaches. The performance of this rule-based approach can be enhanced by modifying and improving the knowledge base only due to the characteristic that knowledge and control logic are separate and independent of each other in knowledge based system. Moreover, ldquoprimitive actionrdquo, ldquopriority of parallel conclusionrdquo, ldquoparallel search methodrdquo and ldquosimple conflict resolution methodrdquo were also introduced to shorten the system's response time. The successful prototype application in robot soccer verified its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Joint frame synchronization and belief propagation decoding for quasi-cyclic LDPC-coded system under pseudorandom noise disturbance
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Because of the quasi-cyclic nature of Quasi-Cyclic LDPC (QC-LDPC) codes, there are ramps in the frame synchronization searching process. A pilotless code-aided frame synchronization algorithm joint with improved BP decoding for QC-LDPC coded system under PN disturbance to eliminate the ramps is proposed in this paper. Simulation results show the validity of the modified BP decoding algorithm and outstanding synchronization performance compared to the algorithm before improvement and hard decision frame synchronization proposed by Dong-U Lee.

articleTitle: Enhance process flexibility by case-based reasoning and process mining
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Current process models are hard to describe uncertain factors in applications before run-time, which results in inflexibility of Process-Aware Information Systems. For this problem, a method to achieve process flexibility by underspecification based on so-called flexible block was proposed. The flexible block is running in ad hoc manner firstly, then it's inside process structure is gotten through process mining after the running history data accumulated to a degree. And then, the application scenarios were matched, and the process model of flexible block was educed through interactive case-based reasoning. Practices indicate the approach proposed by this paper can reuse the modeling knowledge very well. Modeling efficiency of flexible block is improved along with the increase of its executing times. The business process models contained flexible blocks are with high flexibility.

articleTitle: Fuzzy controller for automotive semi-active suspension based on damping control
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In order to improve the control effect of automotive semi-active suspension, a 2-degree-of-freedom (2-DOF) model was set up. Based on the Mamdani fuzzy control strategy, a two-input single-output fuzzy controller based on damping control was established, the computer simulation was carried under the excitations of road surface in the MATLAB/Simulink environment. The simulation results shown that under the excitations of pulse and white noise road surface, the semi-active suspension system with fuzzy control strategy effectively enhanced performance than passive suspension system in vehicle ride smoothness and travel comfort, with peak body acceleration reduced respectively by 31.3%, 22.0% and 22.2%, and with root-mean-square value reduced respectively by 16.9%, 15.6% and 15.5%.

articleTitle: Virtual scene illumination effect and space environment simulation application
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: By manually setting up illumination source or simply employing default light source, VRML system can proceed scene and models' surface material dark-and-light distributed computing, so as to produce real illumination effect for scene and its embedded models. If necessary to carry out shadow rendering, first should artificially calculate shadow range, then through manually program to proceed shadow rendering. Space scene's authenticity virtualization is a key technique in constructing virtual environment application. Two kinds of VRML nodes can be used in atmosphere environment simulation. One is Background node, and the other Fog node. VRML's Fog node's function is to simulate natural atmosphere effects through the definition of explorer's visible fading region. Paper mainly introduced practical application of virtual illumination source, light shadow range calculation and program, LINEAR fog, EXPONENTIAL fog and fog color settings.

articleTitle: Study on fuzzy controller for lorenz chaotic system based on linear matrix inequalities method
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper studied the stability of Lorenz chaotic system control problem. Adopted fuzzy dynamic model approaching non-linear chaotic system to make non-linear chaotic system into a fuzzy local linear model. Used linear matrix inequalities (LMI) theory to solve the fuzzy controller parameters and the public's positive definite matrix P, set up the conditions for the stability control system. Simulation to verify the effectiveness of the program.

articleTitle: The study of music popularity based on online user behaviors about the music hit charts
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Since 1951, for fifty years, music charts ranked musical recordings with selling. Those traditional music charts do not work well with the popularity of musical recordings nowadays because of huge impact of internet over music industry. A new kind of music charts is more and more popular, by which we call it as search charts or hit charts. In this paper, we choose this special music hit charts to study. First we took a series of analysis on the characteristics of music hit charts. Those characteristics of music hit charts are special thanks to the online user behaviors. Then we proposed a novel music categorization method on the basis of online user behaviors. The criterion of our method is to judge the popularity of each song with the variance of hits. In traditional commercial charts, music charts is influenced with economy. Our studies weaken the economy's influence over music popularity.

articleTitle: Convergence property of a class of unconstrained minimization methods with perturbations
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In this paper, we investigate a class of unconstrained minimization methods including Fletcher-Reeves (abbr. FR) conjugate gradient method with perturbations. Their stepsizes are determined by generalized Wolfe line search. We prove that these methods are globally convergent under mild conditions, and in doing so, we remove various boundedness conditions such as boundedness from blow of f, boundedness of level set, etc. At the end of this paper, numerical examples are given.

articleTitle: CCCM 2009 keynote speech
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Provides an abstract of the keynote presentation and a brief professional biography of the presenter. The complete presentation was not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: A novel fast method for computation of zernike moments based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to the fast computation of Zernike moments from a digital image. Most existing fast methods for computing Zernike moments have focused on the reduction of the computational complexity of the Zernike 1-D radial polynomials by introducing their recurrence relations. Instead, in our proposed method, we focus on the reduction fo the cumulative number of the Zernike moments with many PEs (process elements) which are achieved by VHDL(VHSIC hardware description language). The architecture described above was simulated and implemented targeting Xilinx GA(gate array). In the experiments, results show the accuracy of the form for computing discrete Zernike moments and confirm that the proposed method for the fast computation of Zernike moments is much more efficient than existing fast methods in most cases.

articleTitle: Research on dual-Processor sharing single DRAM
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper presents a scheme of dual-port single memory controlling (DSMC) system based on switching, by which the dual-processor can access the shared single DDR SDRAM simultaneously and without collision. Therefore, the symmetric multi-processor (SMP) structure can utilize high-density, low-price DDR SDRAM as the shared memory to improve the system performance significantly. The DSMC system comprises of command interface module, data buffer module, logic arbiter module, quick data path module, DRAM command interface module, clock module and refresh module. The whole design is described in VHDL, and is verified with the FPGA in Xilinx EDK platform.

articleTitle: A study and simulation on measurement of HTS films using CPR technique
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In this paper a coplanar resonator (CPR) structure have been estimated using a full wave spectral domain technique in conjunction with the complex resistive boundary condition. The computer aided design method developed is applied to simulate the characteristics of coplanar resonators. To minimize the radiation loss, the coplanar resonator is usually housed in a conductive cavity. The coupling of the resonating loop has been analyzed by using HFSS. We employ HFSS software to simulate the CPR structure and get resonate frequency at 5.27 GHz.

articleTitle: An inter block mode decision method based on gradient and RDO
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method of Inter-block mode decision based on gradient and RDO (Rate Distortion Optimizing) in H.264. The new method eliminates some rarely-possible modes according to the gradient distribution, which helps to reduce the number of candidate modes during the following RDO procedure. The experiments proves that this method saves about 80% time and the Y-PSNR drop is less than 2 dB, compared with the traditional methods that goes through all modes.

articleTitle: A novel personal firewall configuration method for digital media sever
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: When the DLNA products within the organization joined the home networking; the attacks from the Internet will be guided before one knows that. This article will present a design of personal firewall digital media server (DMS) for DLNA services. With the traditional firewall, the firewall access control lists, can be easily configured and updated. The key design concept of the contact list is based on the use of real-time communication systems. If the digital media controller was added to the contact list management system, the DMC can control and manage the media. Also the DMS can reject the accessing of a DMC on the contact list by temporarily blocking.

articleTitle: QoS decomposition for dependable service-oriented middleware
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In this paper, a dependable service-oriented middleware (DSM) is proposed by introducing the concept of Quality of Service (QoS) into service-oriented architecture. DSM provides a dependable framework with the functionalities of QoS monitoring, configuration and runtime management to fulfill user's QoS request. The overall QoS requirement of the entire composite service is satisfied with the method of planning and guaranteeing the QoS of each atomic service. Our approach is to decompose the QoS requirement for the composite service into separate ones for the atoms, and to deliver expected QoS for each atomic service with adaptive service scheduling mechanisms. This paper first presents a group-based service redundancy management and QoS decomposition model to support dependable service-oriented architecture; then demonstrates the structure and components of DSM; finally experimental results indicate good performance of the proposed framework and algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on general evaluation of regional rural infrastructure supply capacity in China
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Regional supply capacity of rural infrastructure is an important impact of agricultural development level, it related to the level of agricultural development, rural development and farmers' income improving. This paper builds a model of regional rural infrastructure supply level indicator system of China's 31 provinces (region), use of factor analysis on China's regional rural infrastructure supply level then make a comprehensive evaluation about it. On the basis of factor analysis, this paper extracts two main influencing factors: the rural productive supply capacity of infrastructure and rural social infrastructure capacity of infrastructure, then this paper compares the supply capacity of various rural areas, reaches the general ranking of rural infrastructure supply capacity. Thus this paper suggests that the central government and local government should play their important roles, making policy guide and playing the main body's role of infrastructure construction, then we can narrow inter-regional differences supply capacity of rural infrastructure and protect the effective supply of rural infrastructure.

articleTitle: A CG-based method to construct knowledge base from the text in water conservancy domain
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Aiming to provide semantic information for decision supporting system and constructing a domain knowledge base in which knowledge is represented in a formalized form so as to be understood by machine, this paper suggest a new method which is based on conceptual graph to represent knowledge formally. At first, the system architecture would have been designed, and it consists of knowledge acquirement layer, knowledge management layer and knowledge application layer. Then, the crucial technology, formalizing the domain text by conceptual graph, is expatiated by the domain ontology and knowledge is constructed synchronously. By using the specific computational tool named Prolog+CG for representing and reasoning about water conservancy texts, the validity and efficiency of this method are proven.

articleTitle: An ontology-based shared semantic space for interacting between human and computer
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The discrepancy between nature language of user and special language about certain domain is a serious clag for interacting between them, and restrain the application and intelligence of knowledge-based system. In this paper, an architecture named S3 is presented, and some semantic connectors are designed to describe the relation between users' question ontology and system knowledge ontology. For the shared semantic space, an algorithm is designed to calculate the semantic distance of the main components of the sentence with the structure <verb>+<noun>. So, users' questions are mapped to titles of knowledge segment stored in knowledge base, and are knowledge segment as answers ranked according to the semantic similarity. Compared with existing method, this method is more feasible, and can be used in human-machine system to search answer of users' question in knowledge-based system directly.

articleTitle: Service-oriented architecture in business
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper is composed of main points from authoritative articles and reviwed the SOA. It helps to understand SOA in business domain. The contents includes: the new capabilities in SOA, the method of how SOA plays as a service role, SOA's applications, SOA's advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: Research of logistics distribution system based on GIS technology
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Geographical Information System - GIS has strong power in handle, orientation and communication in geographical information, the development and maturity of GIS technology allow that logistics distribution can use it to analyze spatial network and track the distribution process. First, the basic model of logistics distribution system is introduced, then the framework of logistics distribution system based on GIS, the module and function design about the system are discussed in the paper. This framework in the practical application has made impressive result.

articleTitle: Research on layered multicast congestion control
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Layered multicast is one of the most important approaches for dissemination of audio and video in heterogeneous network environments. The main problem in layered multicast application is congestion control. The goals of layered multicast congestion control are analyzed, and layered multicast congestion control method is emphatically discussed. At last, the key problems in layered multicast congestion control are pointed out. The research has a very important value in layered multicast congestion control.

articleTitle: Research on the math model of multi-parameter of new twisting machine
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: To solve the problems of complexity in structure and huge time and energy consumption in operation for different twist yarn in the conventional mechanical twisting machine, a new multi-parameter driving system is developed. With the establishment of the math models of twisting, winding, and guiding-yarn, a multi-motor driving mechanism and the frequency communications technologies are applied in the new twisting machine, which employs two asynchronous motors and two servo motors. With the multi-parameter controlling, the machine structure is simplified. The yarn quality is improved. The productivity is promoted. And mechanical-electrical integration level of the twisting machine is enhanced.
