articleTitle: Sliding mode variable-structure MRAS speed identification for induction motor direct torque control system
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper proposes a novel sliding mode reference adaptive system(SM MRAS) observer for speed identification in a sensorless direct torque control induction motor system. The SM MRAS method uses the Voltage Model (VM) as reference and the Current Model (CM) as adjustable model to estimate the motor speed by combining MRAS with sliding mode variable-structure control to formulate a slide mode surface according to two model output errors. Theoretical analysis shows that the proposed strategy has stronger robustness and satisfactory performance. Simulations show that they yield accurate estimates; good dynamic behavior and resist disturb design.

articleTitle: Power load forecasting based on elman neural network
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The article forecasts the power load with Elman neural network. First of all, it gives the basic principle of Elman neural network, and then it determines the structure parameters, transfer function and training times of model, normalizes the data. It gets a good result with forecasting actual history data of a certain electric network; it shows that forecasting power load with Elman neural network is available.

articleTitle: An IMC-PID controller tuning strategy based on the DE and NLJ hybrid algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: A new IMC-PID tuning method based on combination algorithm of DE and NLJ is proposed in this paper. The IMC-PID controller tuning strategy which is on the basis of internal model control, not only keeps the characteristic of conventional PID controller, but also has the advantages of internal model control. The simulation shows that using this method to tuning PID parameters has good control performance and robustness.

articleTitle: Design of servo system for 3-axis CNC drilling machine based on XPC target
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: As special equipments, the CNC drilling machines require servo systems specially designed. So there is a substantial waste of time and energy. In order to solve this problem, a design proposal for the servo system of 3-axis CNC drilling machine based on xPC Target is presented in this paper. Taking a CNC drilling machine model as the experiment platform, the block diagram of the servo system was designed using SIMULNK tools, and compiled into a real time system by VC complier, which could run on X86 computer. Rapid developing of a servo system for 3-axis CNC drilling machine is easily implemented by this proposal. The experimental results demonstrate that the feed system of the drilling machine model could carry out a quick precision positioning.

articleTitle: A study on the competency model of professional sports coaches in sichuan province
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Originated in the 1970s, the theory of competence has become today's leading issue in the field of management and psychology. The current research interviewed 20 provincial grade and higher sports coaches relating to 8 sports events using the Behavior Events Interview (BEI) in Sichuan province, after which ldquoThe Competency Dictionary of Sports Coaches of Chinardquo was utilized to rate/code the interviews. Moreover, this research constituted ldquoThe Competency Model of Sports Coaches in Sichuan provincerdquo, which includes acquirement of knowledge, consciousness of creation, teamwork, and trust in colleague and promotion of cooperation, authority, self-confidence, and attention to detail. Finally, the study proposed an explanation to the Model.

articleTitle: Seabed terrain matching algorithm basing on correction factor of tide and probability data associate filtering
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The performance of seabed terrain matching in shallow water areas is often unsatisfactory. We made experiments, then found out it is caused by the influence of the tide. This paper remove the effects of tide to the shallow seabed terrain matching by using the tide correction factor, and then provided a nonlinear state estimation methods using optimal probability rules to optimize the seabed terrain matching algorithm. The theoretical analysis and simulation results indicate that the seabed terrain matching algorithm based on correction factor of tide and probability data associate filtering (STMCFTPDAF) can improve the performance of terrain aided navigation compare to TERCOM and TEMPDAF.

articleTitle: An speech enhancement method for AMR based on adaptive perceptual weighting filter
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The paper focuses mainly on speech enhancement methods. Because noise may degrade the quality and the intelligibility of speech, various enhancement technologies are applied in speech processing systems. The speech enhancement method in AMR is based on masking properties of the human auditory system, which performs a comb filter before the open loop pitch analysis. During the entire processing course, the filter is employed. While for the unvoiced part, it may degrade speech quality. In view of the energy of the speech, the paper improves this step by using perceptual weighting filter on voiced speech so as to strengthen pitch and harmonic components and suppress the noise because of its periodicity character. The experiment results indicate that the method can improve the quality and intelligibility of the speech while take less computation load.

articleTitle: A simplified application of regular expressions: With the extraction of Chinese cultural terms as an example
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This article aims to solve the problem of extracting the cultural terms and their correspondent English translations from the heterogeneous literature of the translation of the ancient Chinese classics. As the tool of text processing, regular expressions can help to realize the matching in the patterned text. This research focuses on design the target-oriented regular expressions to fit the pattern of the to-be-searched text so as to improve the operating efficiency. At the same time, the generator of regular expressions is designed to decrease the difficulty of its application.

articleTitle: A conceptual framework and hypotheses for the adoption of e-business intelligence
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: E-business intelligence aims to develop a tremendous spectrum of business opportunities. User's adoption of the business intelligence is very important. Consequently, a deeper insight into theory-based research is required to better understand the motivation that lead users to adopting e-business intelligence. This paper reviews the existing acceptance theories and constructs affecting users adoption behavior are discussed and relevant propositions are made.

articleTitle: A fast convergence mechanism for distance-vector routing protocol
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In order to solve the problem of routing protocols using the distributed Bellman-Ford (DBF) algorithm converge very slowly to the correct routes when link costs increase, and in the case when a set of link failures results in a network partition, we present a new fast converge distance vector routing algorithm CF-DVRP that uses suppression-failure strategy and multiple feasible backups per destination for every node to prevent the count-to-infinity problem. The analysis result show that CF-DVRP provide better network stability and availability and the simulation experiments show that CF-DVRP can deal with the multiple failures effectively.

articleTitle: A noise-robust speech recognition system based on ZCPA features and support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In the noisy environment, the performance of speech recognition system may become worse to some extent. In order to solve this problem, this paper used the zero-crossings with peak amplitudes (ZCPA) features as speech feature parameters, which are based on human hearings property. The extraction method of ZCPA features is that calculating the unward zero-crossing rate of speech signal gets frequency information, compressing amplitudes non-linearly incorporates intensity information, and form finally output features. This paper also used the support vector machine as recognition machine, realized a speech recognition system of non-specific person and isolated words with Visual C++ programming, and got the recognition results in different SNRs and in different words. Experiments indicate that the recognition correct rates based on ZCPA features and support vector machine are much higher than those of based on traditional hidden Markov model, and also have better robustness.

articleTitle: A study of the active router structure
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Active network is a new framework where network nodes not only forward packets, but also perform customized computation on the packet flowing through them. It provides a programmable interface to the user where users dynamically inject services into the intermediate nodes. This paper bring forwards a structure of active router based on IP network, analyses the extended definition field of IP datagram and the format of the active IP datagram, researches the module structure, the logic flow chart and the arithmetic of active router, thereby realizes the active networks technology in IP network and extends the service in existence network.

articleTitle: Mobility-aware multicast over mobile ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Due to the high mobility of nodes and highly dynamic topology, performing efficient and robust multicast in a Mobile Ad Hoc Network (MANET) is a challenging task. Most of existing multicast protocols in MANETs discover the routing path by flooding message over the whole network, which result in considerable cost for routing discovery and maintenance. Moreover, the reliability of the discovered path can not be guaranteed, since the stabilities of nodes along such path are unpredictable. This paper presents the Reliable Backbone based Multicast Routing (RBMR) protocol for MANETs. RBMR employs a mobility prediction based election process to construct a reliable backbone structure performing packet transmission, message flooding, routing discovery and maintenance. Other existing multicast protocols for MANETs can also take great advantage of RBMR to alleviate the influence of nodes mobility and perform efficient data transmission. Simulation results show that such protocol achieves good performance in terms of packet delivery ratio, forwarding efficiency and normalized overhead even in the high speed scenario.

articleTitle: Logistics network design and optimization of closed-loop supply chain based on mixed integer nonlinear programming model
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Based on the optimization theory and product recycle and remanufacturing, a closed-loop supply chain logistics network is designed, and a mixed integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) model is constructed. According to characteristic of the model, improved differential evolution algorithm is adopt to solve the problem. As a result, the facility location problem of closed-loop supply chain logistics network and the best flow distribution on each route have been solved. In the end, the validity and feasibility of this model is validated by a concrete example, and it provide a reference model and algorithm for logistics network design of closed-loop supply chain.

articleTitle: Study on the construction of stereoscopic teaching model: The practice training of e-commerce discipline in SIFT
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: From the development and construction of e-commerce teaching in China, this paper explores a professional approach to definite the critical factors in e-commerce personnel training. Compared with the fast-growing demand for e-commerce talent, the stereoscopic teaching model is proposed from the concept and the implementation. Focused on the comprehensive analysis of the application of this model in SIFT e-commerce discipline, this paper expounds how to enhance the professional capacity of students to practice and innovation in e-commerce area.

articleTitle: Design and realization of an intelligent data acquisition and display system based on AT89C52 and modbus
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In order to achieve real-time remote data acquisition and display, an intelligent data acquisition system based on the Modbus communication protocol and RS-485 bus is designed, which is capable of gathering PT100 signals or the 4 ~ 20 mA industry standard signals. Its hardware system mainly consists of the MCU, the A/D converter, and the modules for communication, storage, power supply, I/O display and reset watchdog, etc. It can save pre-defined parameters, gather the analog data on-site and convert them into digital data for processing, with rich communication functions to the main computer. Its low power consumption, strong anti-interference ability and easy integration options make the system perfect for deployment in general industrial sites to meet various user needs.

articleTitle: Steganalysis of two least significant bits embedding based on least square method
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The purpose of steganalysis is to detect the existence of the hidden messages. In this paper, a steganalysis algorithm against two least significant bits steganography is proposed in order to estimate the hidden message length in images. In the method, firstly we estimate an approximately original image through a local masked estimation function. Then we construct a weighted stego image by extending the definition which was proposed in LSB steganalysis to 2LSB. Finally, detection equation is formulated as a simple optimization problem between approximately original image and weighted stego image. Hidden message length can be easily calculated by solving the detection equation. Experimental results reveal that this algorithm can estimate the length of secret message with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Configuration management process design and implementation
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: As information technology becomes more important to build enterprises' competitive advantage, transforming their IT organization from technology provider to service provider by introducing IT service management (ITSM) processes is also becoming imperative. Configuration management is one of processes in ITSM which plays a key role for successful implementing ITSM. In this paper, we give a set of suggested processes for configuration management, including policies, key activities, roles and responsibilities, RACI matrix, and technical tools, etc.

articleTitle: The extension of the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve to multi-class problems
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The area under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUC) has been successfully applied to binary-class tasks. However, its extension to multi-class problems has become a difficult task due to some practical issues. Up to now, its generalization work is relatively little and is not considerably ideal. In this paper, a new method is presented to estimate AUC for multi-class problems, which not only can obtain the overall AUC but also care how well each class is separated from others. Thus it is a more desirable measure to examine both the overall and detail performances of classifiers with multi-class problem. Moreover, the developed measure is independent on class distributions, which is the singular merit of the standard AUC with binary class task. As a case study, in terms of the developed measure we evaluated three different classification algorithms (NaiveBayes, KNN(5) and C4.5) on the 18 multi-class datasets.

articleTitle: Research on grid resource allocation based on equivalent price
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: An equivalent price based algorithm is proposed, which applies the combinatorial double auction and trust theories into grid resource allocation and pricing. Firstly the price adjusting function is designed, which maps the nodes' bid prices under various trust values into the equivalent prices under base trust degree. Then the grid resources are allocated and priced based on combinatorial double auction. Simulations show the algorithm has high trade rate, reliable security and efficient incentive mechanisms.

articleTitle: The application of AHP and Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation in intellectual capital management of mining enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Intellectual capital in the context of knowledge-based economy is important means of the enterprises survival and development. According to analyze constituent elements of intellectual capital, the index system was proposed by human capital, management capital, technology capital and market capital, index weights were determined by using AHP, the comprehensive evaluation model was established by using fuzzy. Applications used by the model shows that the evaluation result can objectively reflect the intellectual capital management of mining enterprises, a new method and way was provided for evaluation of intellectual capital management, it has theoretical and practical value.

articleTitle: An improved parallel genetic algorithm based on injection island approach and k1 triangulation for the optimal design of the flexible multi-body model vehicle suspensions
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In this paper, we introduced IPGA (improved parallel genetic algorithm), a new parallel genetic algorithm which is based on k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> triangulation of fixed point theory and an injection island approach. This approach guarantees that the processors only generate solutions within their assigned region. And what's more, the k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> triangulation theory is introduced to the genetic algorithm to design convergence criteria objectively and to solve the convergence problem in the later period. The running environment is constituted in this paper and the optimization of multi-body model vehicle suspension is implemented through establishing the interface between ADAMS software and genetic algorithm. The results show that the parallel genetic algorithm developed in this paper is efficient.

articleTitle: Delay modeling and analysis in DTN multicasting
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The main character of Delay Tolerant Networks (DTNs) is that there is not an end-to-end path from the source node to the destinations due to the intermittent connections and mobility of nodes. In this paper, we construct the mathematic model based on queue with vacation theory to analyze the impact of buffer management strategy on DTN multicast routing, and then compute the minimal delay and maximal delay from the source to the destinations according to this model; at last, we do simulation with On-demand Routing, Dynamic Tree Routing and Static Tree Routing algorithms, and the results show that our theory runs well.

articleTitle: A low-overhead method of embedded software profiling
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: With the continuous development of embedded technology, embedded applications are becoming increasingly popular in daily lives, and respectively embedded software is in great demand. As a result, how to profile embedded software to guarantee its quality becomes a focus of attention. This paper focuses on this issue. It analyzes current methods of embedded software profiling and their defects, and then proposes a low-overhead and more accurate method. It also performs some strict experiments to prove that it is effective and much better than current methods.

articleTitle: Chinese text digital watermarking algorithm based on the edges number of junction in the Chinese characters
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In view of the problems of small capacity to carry hidden information and weak robustness, this paper presents a new Chinese text digital watermarking technology based on cognitive features of human psychology, even by changing the edges number of the junction in Chinese characters, design a variety of characters with different breaking and linking stroks in the same semantic, and encoded these characters which have different structures appropriately, carried the digital watermarking information using of the topological structure of Chinese characters. The technology has many characteristics as followings: small visual impact; higher anti-attack ability.

Author Keywords: number of the breaking and linking stroks
embedding and extracting of the watermarking

articleTitle: Study on algorithm of access control system based on face recognition
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In this paper, based on face recognition, the core algorithm is studied, which was applied in Access Control System. This algorithm carries on the Fisher and PCA transformation in the face image, which the main characteristic vector of the PCA is fused to form a new one that is taken as the distinction standard. By means of ORL and Yale face database, the recognition rate is up to 91.5% and 96.7%, respectively. The effectiveness of the proposed face recognition algorithm and its insensitivity to the facial expression, illumination and posture are shown in terms of both the absolute performance indices and the comparative performance against some popular face recognition schemes.

articleTitle: 3D geological modeling of complex reservoir geometries in a lacustrine-delta system, sha19 block of shanian oilfield
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Delta front is distinguished in the Sha19 block, third member of the Funing formation in Shanian oilfield, according to guidelines defined by Mcpherson and others. Four major depositional microfacies are identified consisting of distributary channel, interdistributary bay, mouth bar and sand sheet. The architecture of the reservoir, governed by the facies geometry, is a major source of heterogeneity in clastic systems. Facies distribution, however, are at present mainly implemented as deterministic 2-D maps in reservoir models. Two-dimensional maps are an oversimplified way of representing the complex spatial structure of the distribution of facies. Therefore, three-dimensional facies models were built in study area. The models honour all available case-specific dasiahardpsila data as well as dasiasoftpsila data and it is calculated with sequential indicator simulation, which is an important stochastic geostatistical method. At the same time, the model should be checked up by geological experiences and judgment.

articleTitle: Information hiding technology based on block-segmentation strategy
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper proposes an information hiding method based on block-segmentation strategy. The proposed scheme divides a grayscale image into several 4 times 4 blocks and further segment each block into four small blocks sized 2 times 2. Each small block chooses one reference point to be proceeded with outer embedding process. The chosen points then formed an inner block to be proceeded with inner embedding process for increasing hiding capacity. In addition, the proposed method effectively controls the distortion between the stego image and the original image by using remainder function. In the extracting phase, the proposed scheme subtracts the qualified reference point from each stego pixels to obtain the secret data. The proposed method does not need any extra information to extract the hidden information. According to the experiment results, the performances of the proposed scheme are better then that of Chang and Tseng's scheme.

articleTitle: Two soft start methods for bi-directional DC-DC converter in stand-alone PV system
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Two soft start methods - delay synchronizing rectification soft start method and two-phase soft start method are proposed to achieve soft start for bi-directional converter of double sources in stand-alone photovoltaic power system. Delay synchronizing rectification soft start method is simple but restricted, which is not feasible under light load conditions. Two-phase soft start method can avoid inverse inductor current by implementing soft start of both active switch and passive switch in a wide range of applications. Experimental results are finally given to verify the effectiveness and validity of the proposed soft start methods.

articleTitle: Fast intra-prediction mode decision for H.264/AVC
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In H.264/AVC, intra-prediction is utilized in the spatial domain. There are two types of intra prediction for luma-intra 16 times 16 and Intra 4 times 4. Four and nine modes are supported by intra 16 times 16 and intra 4 times 4, respectively. The full search is used to select the best modes in H.264, which is very computationally expensive. In order to speed up the mode selection procedure, a fast mode decision algorithm for intra prediction in H.264/AVC is proposed in this work. Experiment results show that the proposed method can efficiently save the computation cost with a negligible loss in peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and unnoticeable increment in bit rate.

articleTitle: A new method of performance evaluation for search engine
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In this paper, a user-oriented hierarchical analysis model is constructed so as to discuss briefly about the evaluation of search engine. According to the property that the ratio of corresponding elements is a constant in any two rows of consistency matrix, the indirect judgment information of the judgment matrix is comprehensively used to construct a constrained programming model in order to determine the ranking weight of judgment matrix. And the Genetic Algorithm is used to solve the model. Finally, an example is given to demonstrate this method. The results showed that weight dispersion got by this method is higher, and it is also much easier to identify the optimal plan.

articleTitle: Application of UDT in microseism data transmission system
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: UDT is an application level, end-to-end, unicast, reliable, connection-oriented streaming data transfer protocol. The UDT protocol is completely at user space above UDP. For it bases on the implementation of UDP, so its real-time characteristic performs very well. In the user space, by designing a new congestion control algorithm, also a new mechanism dealing with the packet loss, UDT has enhanced its reliability in the real-time data transmission application. We all know that the microseism data contain a lot of important information, for example, the arriving time of P wave and S wave, magnitude and the location of epicenter etc. So the realtime performance and reliability has become the important target in designing the microseism data transmission system. In this paper, we take the UDT into the application of microseism data transmission system, for the first time, to make a real-time and reliable data transmission. By evaluating UDT's performance in both simulation environments and real networks, we have examined UDT's performance include reliability, real-time, throughput and also the implementation efficiency.

articleTitle: Evaluation and forecast of competitiveness of construction enterprise based on extended DEA model
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: To make accurate appraisal of the competitiveness of construction enterprises, DEA model is adopted and extended. The integrated competitiveness and state of returns to scale were analyzed. The inefficient DMUs were diagnosed and optimized by changing the index and using projection analysis and the efficient DMUs were discriminated by super efficiency and sensitivity analysis. Then, forecast about the competitiveness was made based on the stability result the application proved that the proposed extended DEA model provided a mew idea and method for competitiveness evaluation and management of construction enterprises.

articleTitle: An active control method for vibration isolation of precision equipments
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Vibration limits the performance of precision equipments in numerous applications, thus the need to control the vibration to optimize performance has become crucial. This paper presents an active control method for vibration isolation of precision equipments. First, some basic concepts of vibration isolation are summarized and how to select an isolation system is presented. The desired function of isolation system and the weight distribution of supported equipments should be determined. Secondly, some traditional control methods are reviewed, and their disadvantages are analyzed. Then, a simplified active actuator and its working principles are developed; the displacement of isolated equipment is obtained. Finally, two different control strategies are applied in this active actuator, and the responses predicted by the model agreed well with the experimental measurements. The proposed active vibration isolation can offer an excellent method to control excessive vibration in a wide variety of applications.

articleTitle: Multi-temporal remote sensing data of land use/land cover: Processing and accuracy assessment — A case of Wuhan Metropolitan
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: To Wuhan Metropolitan as an example, based on the conventional remote sensing data processing, aim at the data sources and regional characteristics, constitute the remote sensing data processing methods and processes that suitable for this area, then received the LUCC classified data of Wuhan Metropolitan. Carried out on the accuracy assessment of the Processing results. The results show that, the general classification accuracy of Wuhan city circle three periods 1987, 1996, 2005 is 85.4%, 85.04%, 86.11% respectively, the total Kappa value is 0.7963, 0.7805, 0.8041 respectively. It is a high-accuracy process.

articleTitle: Macroscopic model for interrupted traffic flow of signal controlled intersection
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: For urban road network, traffic flow at the intersections is the interrupted traffic flow. Recently, applied mathematics developed hydrodynamic traffic flow models on networks, in which signal timing was not considered. The paper put forward hydrodynamic model for interrupted traffic flow at the intersection, in which entropy condition was delay minimization. Based on this proposed model, we presented delay calculation method with physical queue.

articleTitle: A novel wide dynamic range digital PSK demodulation
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: An all digital wide dynamic range PSK receiver has been designed and implemented by using field programmable gate array (FPGA) for burst communication applications in an environment with a large frequency offset. The receiver employs the differential detection to increase the receiver's robustness to Doppler shift and the subsampling technique with 1-bit A/D converter at the front to enhance dynamic range and reduce the complexity. The receiver has more then 70 dB dynamic range with 10 Mbps bit rate in a millimeter wave communication system.

articleTitle: A study of virtual enterprise trust based on HEXIE management theory
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: By utilizing the exterior resources, the virtual enterprise is an important organizational model to obtain competitive advantage and achieve rapid growth. Trust is one of the critical success factors of virtual enterprise, and success in virtual enterprise id heavily dependent on establishing and maintaining trust. This paper used HEXIE management theory, established virtual enterprise trust management mechanism's He principle and Xie principle, through coupling He principle and Xie principle, it can strengthen trust among the members to ensure the virtual enterprise efficient operation.

articleTitle: Modeling and optimal selection of manufacturing resources based on UML and AHP
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Modern manufacturing industry demands manufacturing enterprises to increase their agility and robustness. This leads to more effective and efficient organization, management, planning and control of manufacturing resources in the manufacturing enterprises. Based on the precise data of quantity, technical performance, and capacity of manufacturing resources, manufacturing resources should be optimized and assigned according to dynamic manufacturing environment requirements. The physical models of manufacturing resources include the material elements model of manufacturing resources and the model of organizational structure of manufacturing resources. The organizational model is made up of static manufacturing resources and their status information. First, object-oriented method is adopted and UML is used to establish the manufacturing resource model. Then, all evaluation indices and corresponding hierarchical structure are established based on AHP. Finally, a manufacturing resource optimization and selection system is developed with Delphi 7. The system developed is tested by an instance.

articleTitle: A fast algorithm for range sum queries over data stream
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Range sum queries are fundamental part of modern data analysis application. But traditional query algorithms can not be applied on data stream, which is an unbounded sequence of data elements generated at a rapid rate. In this paper, we propose a novel approach for computing range sum from data streams based on wavelet sliding window model. The basic idea is to divide sliding window into equally-sized batch windows and represent the data elements within a batch window using wavelet coefficients, then store these coefficients in a WaveletWindow structure. As a result, range sum queries toward data streams can be converted to compute range sum over such wavelet coefficients. This algorithm takes advantage of the merit of wavelet decomposition for range sum query and achieves superior runtime performance. The extensive experiments verified the effectiveness of our algorithm.

articleTitle: Using the union algorithm of SLM and PTS to reduce PAPR in OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper proposes a union algorithm of SLM and PTS to reduce PAPR in OFDM system. The simulation results show that the union algorithm can better reduce the complexity of OFDM than traditional SLM or PTS algorithm, and equally effective in restraining the growth of the PAPR.

articleTitle: Hybrid particle swarm optimization for continuous problems
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In order to solve costly procedure of search and premature convergence for continuous function optimization problem, an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm combined with Iterated local search (ILS) method is proposed. During the global search process, our algorithm can enhance the local search ability of particle swarm optimization thought adding random perturbation to local search. Some optimization tests of the standard benchmark function confirm that our method has a stronger ability of global optimization and a faster convergence.

articleTitle: Extracting regions of interest based on phase spectrum and morphological approach
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Regions of interest extraction in an image is a useful and challenging problem in image processing and analysis. A new method to extract regions of interest based on phase spectrum and morphological approach is proposed in this paper. Different color feature maps (hue, saturation and intensity) in different scales are selected to analyze the saliency based on feature selection. The phase spectrum of the selected feature map is analyzed and the corresponding saliency map is generated. By segmenting the saliency map using a threshold, a segmented binary image can be got. Then morphological operations are done to improve the binary image. According to the improved binary image, the salient regions can be detected in the input image. The method is shown to be effective and efficient through experiments on many natural images. The experiment results and analysis have been presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Dimension properties of the self-similarity complex networks
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The self-similarity of complex networks has broad practical backgrounds, yet the self-similarity of network has been rarely studied. One of the problems is to explore the origination of self-similarity in real networks. For this purpose, we proposed the information transfer model in network. The volume dimension integrating the information transfer model is given to analysis the self-similarity of complex networks. But the volume dimension measured the self-similarity of network has some shortage, hence, the information dimension also is given to summarize the self-similarity. The two methods statistics the self-similarity of complex network using the box counting. However, the information dimension has some certain objective in measured self-similar compared to the volume dimension.

articleTitle: Efficient migration mechanism for computing units based on mobile agent in distributed simulation system
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Traditional Mobile Agent (MA) migration mechanisms focus mainly on asynchronous distributed system, and thus encapsulate the whole migration process into an inseparable action. The lack of consideration of Time-Space Consistency makes Mobile Agent System (MAS) necessary to be under the control of certain high level architecture (like HLA) in Distributed Simulation Systems (DSS). However, the scheme imports migration latency which is unbearable to those systems with strict restrains on real-time performance. By utilizing the decision ability of the task execution agent, the migration granularity can be decided based on the exact task. Then the better efficient migration scheme can be chosen to meet the synchronous requirement and then decrease the migration latency. Contrast experiment is done and the new mechanism performs better time-efficiency in most conditions. This means that the intelligence of mobile agents can contribute to the migration mechanism details and boost the general performance.

articleTitle: The technology of OPC and its application in supervisory information system of hydropower plant
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In view of the coexistence of multiple control systems in hydropower plant at present, the restrictions of the rate and reliability between the communications of simple bus such as MODBUS, and the limitations of the substantial data communications, this paper proposes a new program using OPC to realize the data transmission between the monitoring software of hydropower plant real-time monitoring system and the PLC or DCS.OPC is a specification interface protocol for connecting the data sources such as devices, databases, etc. with the client applications of the process control. The application of OPC in the supervisor information system (SIS), has provided a highly efficient and reliable new way for the data transmission.

articleTitle: Fuzzy recognition on the working state of noncontancting mechanical seal
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: For better known about noncontacting mechanical seal working state, a method based on fuzzy recognition was brought out. After discussing the necessity and feasibility of the method, approach a comprehensive analysis on state recognition. The research mainly takes leakage, temperature and clearance of the sealing face and other ratios as parameters, finally achieved a reasonable description of the sealing state and was characterized by: (1) comprehensive evaluation of the sealing state using many parameters; (2) reasonable prediction to the possible change trend of the seals working state; (3) an accurate description of the working state; (4) division of the state to be improved.

articleTitle: A novel trusted intranet-access computer model
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Since the end users of intranet generally work in an open environment, user authentication has long been the cornerstone of intranet security. In this paper, we propose a lightweight USB-key based authentication system which can improve the system security and enhance the feasibility of the intranet computers. The system need not reform the BIOS and other basic hardware infrastructure; it completes user authentication by comparing the authentication packet with USB-key information. Besides little cost and easy procedure, this mechanism can effectively improve the security of general purpose computer in the intranet system. Experiment results prove the feasibility and reliability of the model.

articleTitle: Software development of swimming athletes' physical fitness monitor system
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The monitor process of athletes' training function is the basis to make the training move towards the preset aims. It also plays a key role in improving athletic ability, preventing exercise-induced fatigue and swift recovery. In order to make the monitor process in swimming training intelligent, automatic and dynamic, a monitor software has been developed based on Visual Basic 6.0 and Microsoft Access 2003 in the operating system Microsoft Windows 98SE/NT/Me/2000/XP with information management functions about the monitor and evaluation of athletes' physical fitness, function recovery instruction and training etc. And some relevant database has been established to give dynamic analyses about athletes' Physiological Biochemical Index and objective assessment about athletes' physical fitness which can offer individual therapy to the potential or existing problems. The software is mainly applied to the function assessment about athletes' Physiological Biochemical Index; meanwhile, the computerized management is an aid for coaches in making daily training plans, counting the training load and monitoring the swimmers' physical fitness.

articleTitle: Study of government information construction based on BPR
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: The theory of business process reengineering (BPR) is the newest managerial principle. It has archived dramatically as an effective way for the reform of corporations to radically redesign the business processes. BPR is widely used in many other fields due to its remarkable achievements. From the aspect of BPR, this paper proposed e-government planning approach, applied BPR to the government information construction and discussed how to carry out BPR in the e-government. Finally, based on the deep analysis of the characteristics of government work activities, both the fundamental construction and their inter relationship of the new information system in terms of the principle of business process reengineering. In a word, this paper mainly studied the GPR and the value government, which is of some reference significance for actual practice in government information.

articleTitle: Information sharing model of supply chain based on third party logistics providers
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Supply chain fulfills its customer's demand by a network of companies, mainly consisting of suppliers, manufacturers and third party logistics providers (thereafter 3PLs). Firstly, the related literatures are reviewed. And based on Venn diagram, the information sharing mechanism is analyzed to indicate the relationship between the different shared information. Moreover, three information-sharing models are proposed and analyzed, which are the point-to-point model, the interface model, and the integrated manage model. Integrated with the aforementioned analysis, the view is provided to select the matching information sharing model under different conditions. The paper ends with a discussion of directions for future research.

articleTitle: Efficient negotiation strategies in multi-agent meeting scheduling
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In meeting scheduling problem, the agents negotiate meeting times on behalf of their users. In majority of the works on meeting scheduling, the negotiation protocols do not consider scenario when some agents are busy. They do not have mechanism to identify the busy agents. But in the real-life scenario, all the users are not equally busy. In an attempt to overcome this limitation, we have designed our negotiation protocols in such a way that busy agents get more chance to propose a solution to the meeting. This improves the efficiency of negotiation. We have implemented these protocols in a prototype provided by JADE (Java Agent Development Framework) development community. We have also presented experimental results demonstrating the efficiency of these protocols.

articleTitle: Study on the model of aircraft economic classification based on wavelet recursive least square support vector machine(WRLS-SVM)
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Aircraft economic classification has played a fundamental role in field of civil aviation. Aiming at encourage the sustainable development of the air transport industry, the model of aircraft economic classification is set up based on the theory of wavelet recursive least square support vector machine (WRLS-SVM) according to the principle of ICAO, which named as ldquouser paid for by himselfrdquo. Then, in China, the model is used in the practice, the testing result is able to reflect out accurately characteristics of the data, and closely with the value of passenger enjoyed services.

articleTitle: A research on motivating and managing volunteers for large-scale sports events in China
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Using questionnaires, interviews and other methods, the author did research on the the current state of participation motivation of the volunteers for large-scale sports events in China and did analysis on the factors that motivated volunteers, participating in volunteer service, adhere to service and drop-outs with different motivations, and the status of incentive of volunteers involved in voluntary service for large-scale sports events. According to the results, the author has come up with some motivating and managing countermeasures to be taken to inspire volunteers successfully for large-scale sports events: First, sports volunteers legislation; Second, establish motivational mechanism for sports volunteers; Third, the formate specialized sports volunteers team; Fourth, indirectly use external motivation; Fifth, specify managers' and volunteers' responsibilities.

articleTitle: The study on infrared image parallel computing based on improved BSP model
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: This paper analyzes the characteristics of parallel algorithm for Image and real-time processing of image which base on the cluster-computer. An improved double-sync(the bulk synchronous and the cycle of synchronization) BSP model is proposed, which provides the capability of the real-time processing. Under the clustered computer system, we adopt the leaping task allocation algorithm and the method of border extrapolation and interpolation with which the problem of loss of super-step in real-time parallel computing is solved. Moreover, the paper sets up the cluster computer system architecture for real-time image processing, and the parallel algorithms of image by application of lifting wavelet transform has been implemented. The same time, we build the speed up-ratio model and then analyzes the performance of the calculation. In addition, the improved BSP model, the leaping task allocation mechanism and the border task method of the validity have been verified by experiments, which are effectual for increasing the real-time of image.

articleTitle: Project management team strategy in a global environment
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In this paper the common standards of project management are discussed in the context of global environment. In global environment networks play a decisive role because the several activities of the value chain are distributed globally due to market, supply or cost issue. An extensive literature research shows that there is a need for incorporating human factors, especially cultural aspects, in the strategy for planning and control in international projects. Based on these theses some approaches are developed for the stronger consideration of culture in project management standards. The paper presents a completely new view on project management which will lead to a better understanding of intercultural projects and to an increase in the success rate of such projects.

articleTitle: Implementation of virtual time system for the distributed virtual machine monitor
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: In virtualization environment, time system is also a vital part of the whole system just as that in real computing environment. The system of distributed virtual machine monitor (DVMM) is designed to hide the lower distributed hardware resources with the virtualization technology and provide the feature of single system image (SSI) for the upper guest operating system (GOS) and applications. For the DVMM, we design and implement a virtual time system including four parts - keeping of physical time sources, the virtualization of time sources and timer interrupts, and the time synchronization in the VMM layer. This virtual time system not only correctly provides the complete time services for the GOS and user applications, but also properly manages the internal timekeeping to help the DVMM run on multi-machines and provide the feature of SSI to the upper software. With the technology of hardware assisted virtualization, this new virtual time system runs in the VMM layer instead of in user mode. By running the GOS and applications, we verify the functions of this virtual time system.

articleTitle: An owl-based knowledge representation framework for searching semantically emergency preplan
publicationTitle: 2009 ISECS International Colloquium on Computing, Communication, Control, and Management
abstract: Emergency preplan describes domain knowledge for emergency handling. However, most of them are formed in sample text or d document, and it is difficult for emergency decision-makers to achieve related knowledge accurately and quickly. For solving the problems above, we put forward an emergency preplan knowledge representation framework. First, we analyzed emergency preplan textual knowledge and achieved three kinds of knowledge in different levels. Then, an emergency preplan ontology was built and the way to represent emergency preplan knowledge was proposed. Finally, an emergency preplan semantic retrieval system was implemented with the help of ontology reasoning mechanism.
